verdict.rationale: Reclaim has a first-party help article on how its pricing and plans work, and it states that the Lite tier is free for any single user with essential smart time blocking features. That shows some published tier information. A community user mentions paying about $100/year, but no vendor evidence gives per-seat prices or feature inclusions for the paid tiers. Missing for 10: documented per-seat prices for each paid tier, a tier-by-tier feature breakdown, and confirmation that pricing is visible without contacting sales.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales

citations.quote: Lite is available for any single user at no cost to help you take back control of your calendar with essential smart time blocking features.
